title: pi6 geometric sync handshake
description: Broadcast by the orchestrator when its master entrainment phase crosses a π/6 (30°) marker. Nodes slew, never jump, toward master_phase. The 12 sectors correspond one-to-one to the BioChain pump-clock sectors (PUMP.<cycle>.<sector>).

master_phase.description: radians; the master phase at transmission: sector·π/6 plus the phase elapsed since the marker was crossed (zero for an ideally timed sender)
